applyTemplateDesc: Apply firewall template "{{name}}" to this cluster.

applyTemplateDialog.addedAppliedFromNameAt: Added {{applied}} from {{name}} at the top of the cluster's firewall rules.
applyTemplateDialog.addedAppliedOfTotalFrom: Added {{applied}} of {{total}} from {{name}}. Proxmox refused the other {{total2}}; check the cluster's rule list.
applyTemplateDialog.addsLengthAtTheTop: Adds {{length}} at the top of the cluster's firewall rules, above every rule already there, in the order below. Existing rules are not changed or removed.
applyTemplateDialog.thisCanLockYouOut: This can lock you out of the cluster
applyTemplateDialog.rulesAreCheckedFromThe: Rules are checked from the top, so these come before every rule the cluster has now. While the cluster's firewall is on, a DROP or REJECT here that matches the traffic you reach its nodes with — their web UI and API, SSH, or Nexara's own connection — cuts that access off.

createTemplateDialog.name: Name
createTemplateDialog.noRulesAddedYetClick: No rules added yet. Click "Add rule" to start.

firewallTemplatesTable.reusableRuleSetsSharedBy: Reusable rule sets, shared by every cluster
firewallTemplatesTable.noFirewallTemplatesCreateOne: No firewall templates. Create one to define reusable rule sets.
firewallTemplatesTable.couldNotRead: Could not read the firewall templates.
firewallTemplatesTable.name: Name
firewallTemplatesTable.deleteTemplateDescription_one: Nexara deletes the template {{name}} and its {{count}} rule for every cluster. Rules already applied from it are ordinary Proxmox firewall rules and stay in place. It cannot be undone: to get the template back, create it again.
firewallTemplatesTable.deleteTemplateDescription_other: Nexara deletes the template {{name}} and its {{count}} rules for every cluster. Rules already applied from it are ordinary Proxmox firewall rules and stay in place. It cannot be undone: to get the template back, create it again.

confirmFirewallRuleDeleteDialog.nothingWasDeletedTheRule: Nothing was deleted: the rule list of {{owner}} changed while you were confirming. Check the list and try again.
confirmFirewallRuleDeleteDialog.rulesAreDeletedByPosition: Rules are deleted by position — this is position {{pos}} of the rule list of {{owner}}. Nexara sends Proxmox a check that the list is unchanged, so if it has changed since this page loaded, nothing is deleted and the list is reloaded. The rules below it move up one position.
confirmFirewallRuleDeleteDialog.theChangeIsSavedAt: The change is saved at once, with no apply step; the firewall service reads it on its next update, every 10 seconds. It cannot be undone: to get the rule back, create it again.

createFirewallRuleDialog.protocolIsRequiredWhenA: Protocol is required when a destination port is specified.

noSecurityGroups: This cluster has no security groups. Create one under Firewall, Security groups.
failedLoadSecurityGroups: Could not load the cluster's security groups.
disableClusterFirewallDesc: Proxmox stops enforcing every firewall rule in this cluster at once: the cluster's own rules and those of every node and guest. Traffic they block gets through until the cluster firewall is turned on again.

firewallOptionsCard.proxmoxReturnedNoFirewallOptions: Proxmox returned no firewall options for this cluster.
firewallOptionsCard.eachChangeIsSavedAs: Each change is saved as soon as you make it
firewallOptionsCard.whileItIsOffNo: While it is off, no cluster, node or guest rule is enforced.
firewallOptionsCard.whatHappensToIncomingTraffic: What happens to incoming traffic no rule matches.
firewallOptionsCard.whatHappensToOutgoingTraffic: What happens to outgoing traffic no rule matches.

firewallStatusStrip.noRuleIsEnforcedWhile: No rule is enforced while it is off
